title: Tick Size, Competition for Liquidity Provision, and Price Discovery: Evidence from the U.S. Treasury Market
eligible_reason: Single treated unit and single adoption date per event. The DiD regressions (bootstrap_clustered_se.do) are xtreg y i.treat i.n_date, fe vce(cluster instr) on a daily panel of on-the-run Treasury securities (instr = 2, 3, 5, 7, 10 year; 30-year dropped): treat = 1 for the 2-year note after the November 19, 2018 tick size reduction, and in a second set treat_fut = 1 for the 2-year futures after the futures tick change about eight weeks later (sample ss > 1). Each regression has one treated security and one treatment date, so the at-least-two-adoption-dates rule fails; standard errors are wild-cluster bootstrapped over at most five securities. Shipped data are synthetic.
design_notes: Daily security panel, xtset instr n_date. 'Existing model' (cash): xtreg y i.post i.treat i.instr#c.movel1 i.instr#c.mktwide_tvl1 i.instr#c.mktwide_dtl1 i.dow i.holiday i.earlyclose if ss<=2 & instr!=30, fe vce(cluster instr). 'DiD model with security and day fixed effects': xtreg y i.treat i.n_date if ss<=2 & instr!=30, fe vce(cluster instr), with boottest 1.treat==0, reps(9999) weight(webb). Futures analogues use treat_fut on ss>1. Outcome blocks: market quality (bas, pct1tick, log volume, trade frequency, depth logd*, pi_v, etc.), futures market quality (fut_*), fast/slow trader shares (fbbo_*, sprTight_*), price discovery (is*_p5/p10 information shares, varrw*). Placebo versions (bootstrap_clustered_se_PLACEBO.do) rerun on a placebo period. Results assembled into tables in MATLAB (analyze_results_FINAL_CODE.m).
estimators_reported: twfe_two_group_single_date_did (security + day FE, cluster by security, wild cluster bootstrap)
n_adoption_cohorts_note: One treated security (2-year note) with one date (Nov 19, 2018); the futures analysis has one treated contract (2-year futures) with one later date, estimated separately.

specs.exclusion_reason: single treated unit, single adoption date
specs.outcome: bas bas_l pct1tick log_tv_w log_tfreq_w avsz_w wkup_v wkup_fq logd1 logd5 logdt logd*a* pi_v logpi nonzeroba nonzerot rvann absar30 vrm1 pe (one regression per outcome)
specs.treatment_definition: 1 for the 2-year note on and after Nov 19, 2018 (tick size halved)
specs.cluster: instr (5 clusters) + wild cluster bootstrap (boottest, webb weights)
specs.notes: Futures analogue at line 62 with treat_fut on ss > 1 (mkt_qual_reg4.csv etc.).
